relationships.subject: adenylyl cyclase 1
relationships.evidence_quote: post-LTP is abolished in AC1 knockout mice suggesting that CaM is critical for the induction of LTP in the ACC

relationships.subject: CaMKIV
relationships.evidence_quote: CaMKIV, is enriched in ACC synapses and is required for the induction of LTP in the ACC

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF can produce ACC LTP which is believed to occur via an interaction with the AC1-PKA signaling pathway leading to activation of CREB

relationships.subject: NMDA receptors
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of postsynaptic ligand-gated voltage-dependent N-methyl-D-aspartate (NMDA or NMDARs) receptors are the main driver of postsynaptic LTP

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: LTP can also be chemically induced through a bath application of calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) or brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF)

key_findings: Review: ACC and insular cortex synapses undergo LTP contributing to chronic pain and emotional changes.
ACC LTP depends on NMDARs, AC1-cAMP-PKA, CaMKIV and CREB signalling.
